description: Error emitted by HttpClient for non-2xx statuses and network failures. Key fields: `status`, `statusText`, `error` (parsed body), `url`, `message`.
No HTTP response at all: offline, DNS, CORS rejection or aborted request.
RxJS operator that replaces an error with another observable: a fallback value (`of(...)`), `EMPTY`, or a mapped error (`throwError(() => e)`).
Resubscribes (re-sends the request) after errors. `delay(error, retryCount)` returns a notifier observable or throws to stop.
GET, PUT and DELETE can be repeated safely. Retrying a POST may create duplicates.
Signal resource fed by an Observable: `value()`, `hasValue()`, `isLoading()`, `error()` and `reload()`.
Global Angular hook for uncaught errors. Report them to monitoring; handle expected HTTP failures closer to the UI.
